title: Semantic filter (grep by meaning)
description: Filter many lines, files, diff hunks or tool results by relevance to a task, like grep by meaning

task.description: state header, e.g. 'find the line where the crash originates (root cause), not the follow-on symptoms.'

target.description: completes 'Which tagged line is ...?', e.g. 'the root cause of the failure (the first thing that went wrong), not a consequence'

shows.description: completes 'Does the tagged log contain at least one line that shows ...?', e.g. 'the root cause of a failure'

gloss.description: short option text for this line

exists.instructions: Does the tagged log contain at least one line that shows {{shows}}?

combine: keep if exists >= exists_at and line.p >= best_p; drop if exists <= nothing_at; uncertain otherwise
limitations: decides one set of tagged lines (best line + exists); the per-line keep/drop/uncertain verdicts over many items are the `filter` tool's job
probabilities are saturated (use `filter` graded to rank); it reads only what is in state (give heads or summaries)
marginal items (0.77 for a no-match grep) are why the uncertain band keeps by default
notes: # deviation: spec 2.18/5.14: the grey decision is named `uncertain` (the combine grammar reserves the keyword grey); decides one tagged set with a best-line choice and an exists noul, not one verdict per item; the exists options are generic (the u14 body differs in its exists criteria); the line text is JSON-escaped
